explanation: For the selected original node, take the leftmost node in its right subtree; without a right subtree, climb parents until arriving from a left child. The wrapper locates the selected Data value first.
timeComplexity: O(h) successor search, O(n) including wrapper lookup
spaceComplexity: O(1) successor state, plus wrapper lookup recursion
